decision: manifest-pinned coordinator bootstrap with owner-only per-worker secrets and stdio-only qrexec transport
winner: explicit worker manifest + secret directory + durable registry/replay store + transactional runtime

criteria.correctness: high: only declared workers are bootstrapped and authenticated; mission/request mutations retain transactional semantics
criteria.robustness: high for lab: restart-persistent registry/counters and strict secret-file checks; missing or weak configuration fails closed
criteria.latency: low: local file reads at startup and existing framed stdio request path
criteria.resourceUse: low: no daemon network listener or external database dependency
criteria.regressionRisk: low-medium: composes existing tested primitives rather than replacing queue/protocol logic
criteria.qa: tests cover explicit secret selection, POSIX secret permissions, runtime composition, duplicate identity rejection, and undeclared-secret exclusion

alternatives.name: scan all secret files and auto-register workers
alternatives.rejectedBecause: ambient files would become authorization state and stale secrets could silently gain access

alternatives.name: network HTTP coordinator
alternatives.rejectedBecause: adds listener attack surface and duplicates qrexec transport controls

alternatives.name: single shared worker secret
alternatives.rejectedBecause: weakens worker attribution, revocation, and blast-radius isolation

alternatives.name: external transactional coordinator database now
alternatives.rejectedBecause: stronger eventual production option but higher deployment and regression cost before real-Qubes fault evidence

failuresAndLessons: registration cannot safely be inferred from secret-directory contents; authorization must come from an explicit manifest
durable replay counters require workers to exist in the registry before signed requests are accepted, so bootstrap enrollment must occur before serving stdio
secret permission validation should fail closed on POSIX and should never print secret material
